message.content:
This document describes **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for running very large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models on consumer and prosumer hardware. Here are the key technical points:

## Core Concept
- Runs **GLM-5.3-Flash** (321B params, ~18B active, 1M context) and **DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017** (748B params) on local hardware
- Uses a tiered memory system: hot experts in VRAM, next in RAM, rest on NVMe SSD, moved dynamically during chat
- Auto
